Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — EBR on 04/01, exec slot 9:00am PT. We need final slide handoff by EOD tomorrow, and 3x prioritized asks clear for execs.
Ravi (AE): On it. I can finalize the growth slide, need numbers from finance (+ARR delta). @Anya can you confirm the retention stat? :eyes:
Anya (TPM): Retention stat is ready, will drop into the deck tonight. Also flag: integrations team requested a rollback note — should we include a mitigation bullet?
Maya (CSM): Yes include one-liner under risks. Keep it 1 sentence.
Jordan (Solutions): I can prepare the demo cue cards and fallback plan. Want to confirm demo flow: start with 30s context, 2 min demo, 1 min failover. OK?
Ravi (AE): Works for execs. Also need to capture the 5 asks as concrete action items. I'll list them and assign owners.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. Owners: Ravi -> pricing ask; Jordan -> demo + success metrics; Anya -> retention deep-dive; Maya -> renewal path & timeline; Slides-bot -> assemble final deck.
slides-bot: Uploaded draft v3: https://drive.internal/redwood/EBR/customer-489/EBR-deck-v3.pptx
Jordan (Solutions): Reviewed slides-bot v3 — tightened the success metrics slide, moved one chart to appendix.
Anya (TPM): Shared retention export here: /sheets/retention-q1.csv. Numbers match what I called out.
Maya (CSM): Action items recap: 1) Ravi finalizes pricing slide + add ARR delta (due EOD) 2) Jordan finalizes demo cue + backup video (due EOD) 3) Anya attaches retention appendix + mitigation bullet (due tonight) 4) Maya creates exec one-pager + ask script (due EOD) 5) slides-bot assemble and circulate for 10am dry-run tomorrow.
Ravi (AE): Adding small note — ask #2 (discount runway) needs 2 supporting comps, @Jordan can you add a quick comparative slide?
Jordan (Solutions): Yep, will add comp slide to appendix.
Maya (CSM): Scheduling: dry-run 04/01 10:00am PT (30m). Please be on time. If anyone can't make it, ping me.
Anya (TPM): FYI renewal risk flagged as medium — will include mitigations and expected timeline in appendix.
Ravi (AE): Got it. I'll post a short summary in Salesforce with the same asks.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Last ask — please add any blockers below.
Jordan (Solutions): No blockers from my side.
Ravi (AE): Waiting on finance ARR delta (pinged them).
Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll escalate if we don't have numbers by 3pm. :rocket:
